agent_note: Prose. Third-person retrospective historical narration (US West, 1876) with heavy past-tense documentary exposition and embedded period quotations. Gnomic bucket is all present-tense maxims/essayistic argument; every past-tense generalization about the story world was kept as event/past per METHODOLOGY. Quotation marks survive on many quotes here, so the dialogue calls are mark-based; the unmarked ones were judged on register.
